comment_box: Abortions are not illegal federally and taking away the right to abortion counseling or services is a violation of the 5th Amendment due process clause. When the US Constitution was written their dictionary described a living entity as anything that could maintain its own existence. A fetus cannot maintain its own existence until about the third trimester but can kill the mother so it is the governments job to ensure the life of the mother, not the fetus. And secondly as far as I can find in law no man or woman has ever been prosecuted for performing an abortion before quickening, or as Roe defined it - the third trimester EXCEPT when the abortion was done without the woman's permission or the woman died.
